# Playthrough Strategy

Pre-made strategy for the agent, plus the agent's own notes added as it plays. Every chapter has
its own section below with a **Recruits** table (pre-filled by the human) and an **Agent notes**
area (filled in by the agent). Broad, cross-chapter lessons go under **Broad strategy notes**.

## General Strategy

- Always select "yes" to accept side missions when offered the choice to do so.

## Recruiting Units

In each chapter, there are often units that appear as green units (uncontrollable allies) or red units (enemies). These units can often be recruited by executing the Talk action with a specific player-controlled unit, but there are some more complex conditions that have to be fulfilled in order to recruit some characters. For each chapter, you have been provided a list of the recruitable units that appear and the conditions that need to be fulfilled in order to recruit the character. You should try to recruit units if possible, but it is not a strict requirement.

The chapter sections below cover Lyn mode and Hector mode. Eliwood mode is not covered. Recruits are the same on normal and hard difficulty throughout the entire game, so use the list for your mode regardless of difficulty.

## Promoting Units

Fire Emblem has a mechanic known as promotion, where a unit advances to a stronger class. A unit must be at least level 10 to be promoted, although it can go as high as level 20 before being promoted. It is up to you to decide when it is appropriate to promote a unit.

In virtually all cases, a unit is promoted by using a specific consumable item that matches its class. For example, a knight can use a knight crest to be promoted to a general.

## Broad strategy notes

Cross-chapter lessons the agent adds as it plays. Append below.

- fe7_threat treats YOUR units as walls: a tile marked safe can stop being safe once you move the units that were blocking it. fe7_wait's FALLEN line sometimes misreports mid-battle; confirm with fe7_state. A forecast can commit a menu entry (once it committed a Rescue). A range-2-only enemy (Fenrir) still counters at range 2, so only hit it from adjacent tiles.

### Final Chapter — Light (two parts)

**Objectives:**

Defeat Nergal (boss at (8,2), 75 HP, Def 28 / Res 30). Part 2 (dragon) expected after.

**Recruits:**

None.

**Agent notes:**

s01 attempt notes (in progress):
- Restart starts on turn 1 with 7 units; ATHOS HOLDS Durandal(84)/Armads(85)/Sol Katti(8C). Hector has NO weapon until he trades. Trade turn 1.
- fe7_forecast/fe7_act sometimes fail "action menu could not be located" on certain tiles — try an adjacent tile. A forecast once committed a RESCUE (menu entry 0) by mistake; avoid forecasting from tiles next to allies when unsure.
- Lyn is Lv1 Blade Lord (29 HP, Def 6): her death is game over. Keep her carried (by cls3B #5) or far out of all threat. Attempt 2 lost to this on turn 2.
- Attempt 1 (inherited at turn 11) lost Hector at 7 HP. Turn-1 enemy phase killed units #4 (cls22) and #6 (cls1B) both attempts — keep them back.
- Attempt 3: turn 1 trades + all on '.' tiles = no losses (the 'fallen' readings were tool artifacts). Turn 2 killed the 3 mobile morphs (#13,#14 + chip #16) but Eliwood (Lv2, Res 5) died on enemy turn 2 to the Bolting sage E#5 (range 3-10, moves) + archer. Eliwood/Lyn must be full HP and only in reach of ONE attacker, or carried.
- Attempt 4: T2 killed all 3 mobile morphs (Hector crit, Athos double, Pent double). Athos killed the Bolting sage on T5, but the axe pair (E#8/E#9, cls13) reached 'safe' tiles: fe7_threat counts YOUR units as walls, so tiles behind units you then move are NOT safe. Eliwood died -> game over. Army: Eliwood, Hector, Lyn, Athos, Pent (sage), Hawkeye (berserker), Louise (sniper, bow range 2 only). NO healer.
- Attempt 5 (best so far): T1 Athos to (8,20) and trades Armads to Hector at (7,20); Eliwood/Lyn trade with him; no damage. T2 Athos kills archer #13, Pent+Louise kill #16, Hector+Hawkeye melee #14. T3 carry Lyn. T4 Athos kills Bolting sage from (8,18); axe pair died to Athos counters. T5-6 E#10/E#11 shot from pocket tiles (12,21)/(13,21) across the wall (no counter). Then the NOMAD E#12 (chF8, magic weapon 3D, range 1-2, Move 8, ~29 dmg vs Hector, 38 vs Eliwood) + bishop E#15 arrive from SW on T6: killed Hawkeye (carrying halves Spd -> doubled) and then Hector. POCKET = (12-14,21-22), only entrance (12,23); plug it with ATHOS (takes 14 from the nomad, 0 from the bishop) and keep Hector/lords inside.
- Attempt 6: same opening, all good to T6 (Louise's 0x6C is an ELIXIR - full heal). But Bolting hit Eliwood in the pocket T3 (28), and on T6 the nomad (already at (6,22) at T6 start) hit Hector at (13,19) - a dead end where he could not escape - and killed him T7. Lesson: on T6 KILL the nomad when it arrives: Athos 19 at range 2, Hawkeye melee 16 with 59% crit, Hector 23 finisher. Never park Hector at (13,19). Item probe on Lyn's 0x74 (Hero Crest) weirdly traded her 0x74/0x63 to Athos and spent her turn.
- Attempt 7: T2 Hawkeye missed #14 (cls30, 55 HP, Fenrir range 2 ONLY, AS 25) -> it survived at 34 and DOUBLED Lyn (AS 5) for 44 at (8,25): game over T2. #14 has only 3 melee tiles (10,20),(9,21),(10,22). Lyn/Eliwood get doubled by nearly everything. T2 plan for attempt 8: Louise shoots #14 first (6), then Hawkeye (59% crit), Hector, Eliwood in melee; Athos doubles #13; Pent + Lyn (melee, archers cannot counter) kill #16.
- Attempt 8: Louise attacked #14 from range 2 and was COUNTERED to death (its Fenrir IS range 2 - only melee is safe). Pent vanished from the roster mid-turn (unknown). Lyn died T2 EP. Eliwood's 0x87 = Earth Seal; kills that drop items onto a 5-item unit open a discard menu (Rienfleche).
- PLAN for attempt 9: carry BOTH lords from T1 (Hector carries Eliwood from (9,19); Hawkeye carries Lyn from (7,21); Pent to (6,22), Louise to (6,21)). T2 kill #14 with melee only: Athos tome at range 1 (no counter), Hector, Pent tome at range 1. Archers only scratch tanks.
- Attempt 9 (BEST): plan above worked. T2 Athos 26 + Pent 11 (both point-blank, no counter) + Louise crit killed #14; T3 Pent/Louise finished archers; T4 Athos killed sage from (7,17), axes died on Athos T4EP; T5 Pent+Athos+Louise killed E#10/E#11 from the pocket; T6 lords dropped inside pocket (Eliwood 14,22 / Lyn 13,21), Pent plug (12,23), Athos chips nomad; T7 Athos kills nomad (it sat 2 tiles away), T8 Athos kills bishop. Then MISTAKE: Athos left outside at (8,22) and the HERO E#6 (cls10, chF4, weapon 0x90, ATK ~40, AS ~27, Def18 Res22, melee only) doubled him dead T8EP; army collapsed. Lesson: on T8 focus the Hero: Athos 22 at range 2 (no counter) + Pent 7x2 + Hawkeye melee (59% crit), and keep Athos away from it. Without Athos, Nergal (75 HP, Def 28, Res 30) is unbeatable.
- Attempt 10 (s01, LEFT IN PROGRESS, turn 11): Athos crit #14 and Pent crit #13 on T2, but the sage Bolted Hector twice (47->5; it targets carriers). Athos killed sage T4 and both axes, then sat at 9 HP; Pent and Louise died T5EP to the early-arriving nomad/bishop; Hawkeye crit-killed the nomad T7. Athos fled north to (7,8) and then to (7,14) and died T8EP to E#3/E#4/E#7/E#11; Hawkeye died T9EP. Board now: Eliwood 1 HP, Hector 5 HP carrying Lyn, all in the pocket; enemies stopped advancing (stalemate). The chapter is NOT winnable from here (no Athos, Nergal walled off). The runbook forbids a deliberate restart on attempt >=4, so s01 stopped and is handing this to the human: suggest allowing a Restart Chapter.
- s02 ended attempt 10 (Eliwood attacked at 1 HP -> game over) and restarted.
- Attempt 11 (s02): T1 safe (Lyn to (7,21), Hawkeye rescues her at (6,21); Pent (6,22); Athos (8,20) gives Armads to Hector; Hector rescues Eliwood from (9,19); Louise (7,21)). T2 Athos crit #14 from (10,20), Pent 40 + Hector killed #13, Louise killed #16 (took 18). T3 Athos killed sage from (7,17); Louise Elixir. T4 Athos killed E#8 from (5,18) (axe equipped, no counter); Pent chipped E#9 and was hit to 1 HP. T5 killed E#9, but the nomad/bishop door (4,23) AND the generals opened that turn. T6 Athos killed E#11, Pent chipped E#10 (Athos counter killed it); Pent+Louise died T6EP. T7 the pocket with no plug: the nomad reached (12,22) INSIDE it and killed Hawkeye (carrying Lyn, doubled + crit). T8 Lyn trapped -> lost. Athos also got stuck at (13,19) (dead end behind the paladin).
- Door timing seen: sage room opens by T2EP, warriors T3EP, nomad/bishop + generals T5, Hero/paladin T6. With no plug, the nomad (Move 8) gets into the pocket by T7. Plug (12,23) BEFORE T6EP, and only with Athos.
- Attempt 12 (s02): same T1. T2 Athos 26 + Hector 21 + Pent finished #14; Hawkeye crit-killed #13 from (9,23); Louise killed #16. T3 the sage stopped at (5,15), out of reach; it Bolted Hector twice (47->3). T4 Louise (crit) killed the sage from (7,21) and Athos killed E#8 from (6,19); Pent died at (12,21) in the pocket (the generals came out at (12-13,19); 0x17 is probably a JAVELIN even though fe7_threat lists it as 1-1) and Louise died to E#9. T5 E#9 died on Athos's counter at (6,17). From T6 the WHOLE enemy army chases Athos: Hawkeye plugging (12,23)/(12,24) kept the lords safe and killed the bishop (crit). Athos at the warriors' doorway (3,18) killed the nomad and a general on counters, but then he was trapped (the room is a dead end) and the Hero/general killed him on T10.
- Excalibur (0x3D, the nomad's drop) cannot be swung by Athos (weapon list offers only Forblaze). Athos's real damage: Forblaze 44 ATK.
- Big lesson: the enemies swarm whichever unit is outside. A tile with ONE melee approach (the pocket entrance, the (3,18) doorway) plus Athos's 1-2 range counters is how kills happen. Never put Athos in a dead end without an exit.
- Attempt 12 end: with Athos dead, Hawkeye at (12,24) still counter-killed the Hero (T11EP), then died to the paladin; Lyn died T13 -> game over. Mani Katti does 0 to the paladin (Def 21).
- PLAN for attempt 13: FORTRESS = Hawkeye plug at (12,24) (only (11,24) can melee it) + Athos at (12,23) behind him (hits (11,24) and (10,23)). Fully safe interior tiles: (13,22),(14,21),(14,22) for Eliwood/Lyn/Hector; (12,22) is exposed only from (10,22); (12,21)/(13,21) to javelins from (12,19)/(13,19).
- Attempt 13 (s02, best so far): T1-T4 as in attempt 12 (Louise killed the sage from (7,21) on T4, Athos killed E#8 from (6,19), lords dropped at (13,22)/(14,21) with Hector at (14,22)). T5 Pent RESCUED Louise from (11,24) after she fled to (10,24); Athos waited at (5,19) (only E#9 reaches it) and E#9 died on his counter. T6 Hawkeye crit-killed the NOMAD from (9,24) (16 dmg, 59% crit, no double); Athos chipped the bishop. T6EP E#10 died on Athos's counter but Athos fell 40->16. T7 Athos+Pent killed E#11, the bishop is down to 13 (it heals by draining). T8 the Hero (52) + paladin (60) arrived; Hawkeye (30 HP) died to the paladin's DOUBLE javelin inside the pocket at (12,22). T9 the Hero at (11,24): Hector at (12,24) takes 13x2=26 (Hit 100%) vs his 25 HP -> I could not plug; Athos at (12,23) died, then the lords.
- KEY: Hector at FULL HP is the Hero/paladin/general tank at (12,24) (Def 30 there: Hero 13x2, javelin 0). Hector lost 22 to a T2EP Bolting in attempts 12 and 13 because the sage targets the CARRIER (halved avoid). Next time Pent carries Eliwood (Pent Res 20) so Hector stays at 47. Lyn's 0x63 cannot be used.
- Attempt 14 (s02): T2 Athos crit #14, Hawkeye crit #13, Pent killed #16 point-blank (21x2) -> no damage taken; Bolting missed. T3 Athos killed the sage at (5,17) from (7,17). Pocket formation was FLAWLESS (lords at (14,21)/(14,22), Hector plug (12,24)); Hector crit-killed the nomad from (8,25), Hawkeye+Hector killed the bishop. But Athos never got back: T4 he went to (11,17) (wrong way), T5 killed E#8 from (8,15), and then the Hero, paladin, generals and E#9 converged on him in the north; he died T7EP to E#9 at 9 HP. Later Hector died at the plug (E#11 did 12/turn, then the Hero hit him) -> game over. Pent and Louise cannot rescue Eliwood or Athos (only Louise and Lyn are light enough for Pent).
- PLAN for attempt 15: after T3, Athos goes STRAIGHT to (12,23) (T3 (12,24) or (11,24), T4 (12,23)). Final: Hector (12,24), Athos (12,23), Hawkeye (13,22), lords (14,21)/(14,22), Pent carrying Louise at (12,22). Keep Louise's Elixir for Hector right before the Hero arrives (~T9). Let Louise/Pent kill the sage when it walks in.
- Attempt 15 (s02): T2 clean again; Louise used the Elixir T3 (13 HP). With everyone in the pocket by T4, the sage (Bolting 3-10) just sat outside and Bolted whoever was uncarried (Lyn 29->5 right after being dropped). By T6 the whole army was at the mouth: Hector at the plug took 28 in one phase (E#9 + bow + sage) and Hawkeye at the plug took 54 the next. Game over T7. Turtling early does NOT work: the sage must die first (T3-T4) and the waves must be fought as they come out (attempt 13's flow), with the pocket used only for the lords.
- Attempt 16 (s02): the Athos->Hector Armads trade failed twice on (8,20) ("menu could not be located"), so Hector TOOK Armads from Athos instead (works) but could not also carry Eliwood; she took 21 from archer #16 on T2EP. T3 Hector carried her and was Bolted (47->24). T4 Athos killed the sage at (5,18) from (7,18) but both warriors could reach him: E#9 hit (31) and died on the counter, then E#8's bow finished him. RULE: Athos never ends a turn where TWO heavy hitters reach him; at T4 prefer killing E#8 (no counter while its axe is equipped) over a sage kill that exposes him to both warriors.
- Attempt 17 (s02): T2-T3 clean (all Boltings missed). T4 Athos hit E#8 from (6,19) but E#8 (61 HP that attempt) was NOT doubled (38 x1), so both warriors reached him; both died on his counters but he fell to 9 HP. T5 he killed the sage at its door (4,13) from (6,13), then the NW room's E#4 (cls1E) CAME OUT and killed him. E#3/E#4 DO move once something is in range. Then the pocket fell (Pent, Louise, Lyn). FORECAST E#8 before counting on a double: its HP and Spd vary between attempts.
- Attempt 18 (s02): sage killed T3 from (7,17) with no damage; but Athos was chased north by the warriors and the Hero/paladin came out of their room (12,13) next to him on T6; he died T7EP.
- RESEARCH (FE7 walkthroughs): the stairs to Nergal (the 'Wall' at (7-9,5-7)) OPEN ONLY AFTER ALL OTHER ENEMIES ARE DEAD; one turn later 3 generals appear below and 2 druids above Nergal. Athos with AUREOLA (item 0x86) does almost half of Nergal's HP; wait out Nergal's counter between attacks. Never take Athos north of row 14 once T5 passes (the Hero's room at (12,13) opens T6).
- s02 SUMMARY: played attempts 11-18, all lost (game over each time; best runs killed sage, warriors, nomad, bishop and generals before Athos fell to the Hero/warriors). Session ended with the game on the GAME OVER / title screen after attempt 18; the next session should pick Restart Chapter (one Down from Resume) and Start (Left then A) on the confirm. Winning needs ALL non-Nergal enemies dead (incl. the NW room pair E#3/E#4 and the throne casters E#1/E#2), then the 5 reinforcements, then Nergal with Aureola. Realistically this roster/save may need human help (e.g. a different save or more units).
- Nergal's throne (8,2) is walled off: (7-9,5-7) read 'Wall', so a path must open by an event (kill all the morphs? a turn count?). Unverified.
- Hard truths: no healer, Hector Res 12 is the sage's favourite target, and Athos dies to any physical double (Hero E#6, axes). Only Athos can hurt Nergal.

T2 Athos crit #14 from (10,20), Pent 40 + Hector killed #13, Louise killed #16 (took 18). T3 Athos killed sage from (7,17); Louise Elixir. T4 Athos killed E#8 from (5,18) (axe equipped, no counter); Pent chipped E#9 and was hit to 1 HP. T5 killed E#9, but the nomad/bishop door (4,23) AND the generals opened that turn. T6 Athos killed E#11, Pent chipped E#10 (Athos counter killed it); Pent+Louise died T6EP. T7 the pocket with no plug: the nomad reached (12,22) INSIDE it and killed Hawkeye (carrying Lyn, doubled + crit). T8 Lyn trapped -> lost. Athos also got stuck at (13,19) (dead end behind the paladin).
- Door timing seen: sage room opens by T2EP, warriors T3EP, nomad/bishop + generals T5, Hero/paladin T6. With no plug, the nomad (Move 8) gets into the pocket by T7. Plug (12,23) BEFORE T6EP, and only with Athos.
- Attempt 12 (s02): same T1. T2 Athos 26 + Hector 21 + Pent finished #14; Hawkeye crit-killed #13 from (9,23); Louise killed #16. T3 the sage stopped at (5,15), out of reach; it Bolted Hector twice (47->3). T4 Louise (crit) killed the sage from (7,21) and Athos killed E#8 from (6,19); Pent died at (12,21) in the pocket (the generals came out at (12-13,19); 0x17 is probably a JAVELIN even though fe7_threat lists it as 1-1) and Louise died to E#9. T5 E#9 died on Athos's counter at (6,17). From T6 the WHOLE enemy army chases Athos: Hawkeye plugging (12,23)/(12,24) kept the lords safe and killed the bishop (crit). Athos at the warriors' doorway (3,18) killed the nomad and a general on counters, but then he was trapped (the room is a dead end) and the Hero/general killed him on T10.
- Excalibur (0x3D, the nomad's drop) cannot be swung by Athos (weapon list offers only Forblaze). Athos's real damage: Forblaze 44 ATK.
- Big lesson: the enemies swarm whichever unit is outside. A tile with ONE melee approach (the pocket entrance, the (3,18) doorway) plus Athos's 1-2 range counters is how kills happen. Never put Athos in a dead end without an exit.
- Attempt 12 end: with Athos dead, Hawkeye at (12,24) still counter-killed the Hero (T11EP), then died to the paladin; Lyn died T13 -> game over. Mani Katti does 0 to the paladin (Def 21).
- PLAN for attempt 13: FORTRESS = Hawkeye plug at (12,24) (only (11,24) can melee it) + Athos at (12,23) behind him (hits (11,24) and (10,23)). Fully safe interior tiles: (13,22),(14,21),(14,22) for Eliwood/Lyn/Hector; (12,22) is exposed only from (10,22); (12,21)/(13,21) to javelins from (12,19)/(13,19).
- Attempt 13 (s02, best so far): T1-T4 as in attempt 12 (Louise killed the sage from (7,21) on T4, Athos killed E#8 from (6,19), lords dropped at (13,22)/(14,21) with Hector at (14,22)). T5 Pent RESCUED Louise from (11,24) after she fled to (10,24); Athos waited at (5,19) (only E#9 reaches it) and E#9 died on his counter. T6 Hawkeye crit-killed the NOMAD from (9,24) (16 dmg, 59% crit, no double); Athos chipped the bishop. T6EP E#10 died on Athos's counter but Athos fell 40->16. T7 Athos+Pent killed E#11, the bishop is down to 13 (it heals by draining). T8 the Hero (52) + paladin (60) arrived; Hawkeye (30 HP) died to the paladin's DOUBLE javelin inside the pocket at (12,22). T9 the Hero at (11,24): Hector at (12,24) takes 13x2=26 (Hit 100%) vs his 25 HP -> I could not plug; Athos at (12,23) died, then the lords.
- KEY: Hector at FULL HP is the Hero/paladin/general tank at (12,24) (Def 30 there: Hero 13x2, javelin 0). Hector lost 22 to a T2EP Bolting in attempts 12 and 13 because the sage targets the CARRIER (halved avoid). Next time Pent carries Eliwood (Pent Res 20) so Hector stays at 47. Lyn's 0x63 cannot be used.
- Attempt 14 (s02): T2 Athos crit #14, Hawkeye crit #13, Pent killed #16 point-blank (21x2) -> no damage taken; Bolting missed. T3 Athos killed the sage at (5,17) from (7,17). Pocket formation was FLAWLESS (lords at (14,21)/(14,22), Hector plug (12,24)); Hector crit-killed the nomad from (8,25), Hawkeye+Hector killed the bishop. But Athos never got back: T4 he went to (11,17) (wrong way), T5 killed E#8 from (8,15), and then the Hero, paladin, generals and E#9 converged on him in the north; he died T7EP to E#9 at 9 HP. Later Hector died at the plug (E#11 did 12/turn, then the Hero hit him) -> game over. Pent and Louise cannot rescue Eliwood or Athos (only Louise and Lyn are light enough for Pent).
- PLAN for attempt 15: after T3, Athos goes STRAIGHT to (12,23) (T3 (12,24) or (11,24), T4 (12,23)). Final: Hector (12,24), Athos (12,23), Hawkeye (13,22), lords (14,21)/(14,22), Pent carrying Louise at (12,22). Keep Louise's Elixir for Hector right before the Hero arrives (~T9). Let Louise/Pent kill the sage when it walks in.
- Attempt 15 (s02): T2 clean again; Louise used the Elixir T3 (13 HP). With everyone in the pocket by T4, the sage (Bolting 3-10) just sat outside and Bolted whoever was uncarried (Lyn 29->5 right after being dropped). By T6 the whole army was at the mouth: Hector at the plug took 28 in one phase (E#9 + bow + sage) and Hawkeye at the plug took 54 the next. Game over T7. Turtling early does NOT work: the sage must die first (T3-T4) and the waves must be fought as they come out (attempt 13's flow), with the pocket used only for the lords.
- Attempt 16 (s02): the Athos->Hector Armads trade failed twice on (8,20) ("menu could not be located"), so Hector TOOK Armads from Athos instead (works) but could not also carry Eliwood; she took 21 from archer #16 on T2EP. T3 Hector carried her and was Bolted (47->24). T4 Athos killed the sage at (5,18) from (7,18) but both warriors could reach him: E#9 hit (31) and died on the counter, then E#8's bow finished him. RULE: Athos never ends a turn where TWO heavy hitters reach him; at T4 prefer killing E#8 (no counter while its axe is equipped) over a sage kill that exposes him to both warriors.
- Attempt 17 (s02): T2-T3 clean (all Boltings missed). T4 Athos hit E#8 from (6,19) but E#8 (61 HP that attempt) was NOT doubled (38 x1), so both warriors reached him; both died on his counters but he fell to 9 HP. T5 he killed the sage at its door (4,13) from (6,13), then the NW room's E#4 (cls1E) CAME OUT and killed him. E#3/E#4 DO move once something is in range. Then the pocket fell (Pent, Louise, Lyn). FORECAST E#8 before counting on a double: its HP and Spd vary between attempts.
- Attempt 18 (s02): sage killed T3 from (7,17) with no damage; but Athos was chased north by the warriors and the Hero/paladin came out of their room (12,13) next to him on T6; he died T7EP.
- RESEARCH (FE7 walkthroughs): the stairs to Nergal (the 'Wall' at (7-9,5-7)) OPEN ONLY AFTER ALL OTHER ENEMIES ARE DEAD; one turn later 3 generals appear below and 2 druids above Nergal. Athos with AUREOLA (item 0x86) does almost half of Nergal's HP; wait out Nergal's counter between attacks. Never take Athos north of row 14 once T5 passes (the Hero's room at (12,13) opens T6).
- s02 SUMMARY: played attempts 11-18, all lost (game over each time; best runs killed sage, warriors, nomad, bishop and generals before Athos fell to the Hero/warriors). Session ended with the game on the GAME OVER / title screen after attempt 18; the next session should pick Restart Chapter (one Down from Resume) and Start (Left then A) on the confirm. Winning needs ALL non-Nergal enemies dead (incl. the NW room pair E#3/E#4 and the throne casters E#1/E#2), then the 5 reinforcements, then Nergal with Aureola. Realistically this roster/save may need human help (e.g. a different save or more units).
- Nergal's throne (8,2) is walled off: (7-9,5-7) read 'Wall', so a path must open by an event (kill all the morphs? a turn count?). Unverified.
- Hard truths: no healer, Hector Res 12 is the sage's favourite target, and Athos dies to any physical double (Hero E#6, axes). Only Athos can hurt Nergal.

- LESSON: the plug must have > bishop drain (~22 vs Hector) + Hero 26 HP; kill or avoid the bishop before the Hero arrives (~T8), or plug with Athos vs the bishop (it does 0 to him) and swap Hector in only when the Hero is adjacent.

+- s03 attempt 31: replayed attempt 30's line (Athos crit-killed #14 on T2 and the Rienfleche drop was discarded via Up/A/Left/A). T8: Hero (10,21), paladin (10,19), bishop (10,24) arrived together at the pocket mouth; Hawkeye (10 HP) screened at (12,24), Hector (25) behind at (12,23); both died T8EP -> game over.

+- THE WALL: by T8 the Hero, paladin and bishop reach the pocket together, and nobody left can take the Hero (it doubles everyone; only Athos at range 2 hurts it, and Athos is stuck in the west room). content.content:
### Final Chapter — Light (two parts)

**Objectives:**

Defeat Nergal (boss at (8,2), 75 HP, Def 28 / Res 30). Part 2 (dragon) expected after.

**Recruits:**

None.

**Agent notes:**

s01 attempt notes (in progress):
- Restart starts on turn 1 with 7 units; ATHOS HOLDS Durandal(84)/Armads(85)/Sol Katti(8C). Hector has NO weapon until he trades. Trade turn 1.
- fe7_forecast/fe7_act sometimes fail "action menu could not be located" on certain tiles — try an adjacent tile. A forecast once committed a RESCUE (menu entry 0) by mistake; avoid forecasting from tiles next to allies when unsure.
- Lyn is Lv1 Blade Lord (29 HP, Def 6): her death is game over. Keep her carried (by cls3B #5) or far out of all threat. Attempt 2 lost to this on turn 2.
- Attempt 1 (inherited at turn 11) lost Hector at 7 HP. Turn-1 enemy phase killed units #4 (cls22) and #6 (cls1B) both attempts — keep them back.
- Attempt 3: turn 1 trades + all on '.' tiles = no losses (the 'fallen' readings were tool artifacts). Turn 2 killed the 3 mobile morphs (#13,#14 + chip #16) but Eliwood (Lv2, Res 5) died on enemy turn 2 to the Bolting sage E#5 (range 3-10, moves) + archer. Eliwood/Lyn must be full HP and only in reach of ONE attacker, or carried.
- Attempt 4: T2 killed all 3 mobile morphs (Hector crit, Athos double, Pent double). Athos killed the Bolting sage on T5, but the axe pair (E#8/E#9, cls13) reached 'safe' tiles: fe7_threat counts YOUR units as walls, so tiles behind units you then move are NOT safe. Eliwood died -> game over. Army: Eliwood, Hector, Lyn, Athos, Pent (sage), Hawkeye (berserker), Louise (sniper, bow range 2 only). NO healer.
- Attempt 5 (best so far): T1 Athos to (8,20) and trades Armads to Hector at (7,20); Eliwood/Lyn trade with him; no damage. T2 Athos kills archer #13, Pent+Louise kill #16, Hector+Hawkeye melee #14. T3 carry Lyn. T4 Athos kills Bolting sage from (8,18); axe pair died to Athos counters. T5-6 E#10/E#11 shot from pocket tiles (12,21)/(13,21) across the wall (no counter). Then the NOMAD E#12 (chF8, magic weapon 3D, range 1-2, Move 8, ~29 dmg vs Hector, 38 vs Eliwood) + bishop E#15 arrive from SW on T6: killed Hawkeye (carrying halves Spd -> doubled) and then Hector. POCKET = (12-14,21-22), only entrance (12,23); plug it with ATHOS (takes 14 from the nomad, 0 from the bishop) and keep Hector/lords inside.
- Attempt 6: same opening, all good to T6 (Louise's 0x6C is an ELIXIR - full heal). But Bolting hit Eliwood in the pocket T3 (28), and on T6 the nomad (already at (6,22) at T6 start) hit Hector at (13,19) - a dead end where he could not escape - and killed him T7. Lesson: on T6 KILL the nomad when it arrives: Athos 19 at range 2, Hawkeye melee 16 with 59% crit, Hector 23 finisher. Never park Hector at (13,19). Item probe on Lyn's 0x74 (Hero Crest) weirdly traded her 0x74/0x63 to Athos and spent her turn.
- Attempt 7: T2 Hawkeye missed #14 (cls30, 55 HP, Fenrir range 2 ONLY, AS 25) -> it survived at 34 and DOUBLED Lyn (AS 5) for 44 at (8,25): game over T2. #14 has only 3 melee tiles (10,20),(9,21),(10,22). Lyn/Eliwood get doubled by nearly everything. T2 plan for attempt 8: Louise shoots #14 first (6), then Hawkeye (59% crit), Hector, Eliwood in melee; Athos doubles #13; Pent + Lyn (melee, archers cannot counter) kill #16.
- Attempt 8: Louise attacked #14 from range 2 and was COUNTERED to death (its Fenrir IS range 2 - only melee is safe). Pent vanished from the roster mid-turn (unknown). Lyn died T2 EP. Eliwood's 0x87 = Earth Seal; kills that drop items onto a 5-item unit open a discard menu (Rienfleche).
- PLAN for attempt 9: carry BOTH lords from T1 (Hector carries Eliwood from (9,19); Hawkeye carries Lyn from (7,21); Pent to (6,22), Louise to (6,21)). T2 kill #14 with melee only: Athos tome at range 1 (no counter), Hector, Pent tome at range 1. Archers only scratch tanks.
- Attempt 9 (BEST): plan above worked. T2 Athos 26 + Pent 11 (both point-blank, no counter) + Louise crit killed #14; T3 Pent/Louise finished archers; T4 Athos killed sage from (7,17), axes died on Athos T4EP; T5 Pent+Athos+Louise killed E#10/E#11 from the pocket; T6 lords dropped inside pocket (Eliwood 14,22 / Lyn 13,21), Pent plug (12,23), Athos chips nomad; T7 Athos kills nomad (it sat 2 tiles away), T8 Athos kills bishop. Then MISTAKE: Athos left outside at (8,22) and the HERO E#6 (cls10, chF4, weapon 0x90, ATK ~40, AS ~27, Def18 Res22, melee only) doubled him dead T8EP; army collapsed. Lesson: on T8 focus the Hero: Athos 22 at range 2 (no counter) + Pent 7x2 + Hawkeye melee (59% crit), and keep Athos away from it. Without Athos, Nergal (75 HP, Def 28, Res 30) is unbeatable.
- Attempt 10 (s01, LEFT IN PROGRESS, turn 11): Athos crit #14 and Pent crit #13 on T2, but the sage Bolted Hector twice (47->5; it targets carriers). Athos killed sage T4 and both axes, then sat at 9 HP; Pent and Louise died T5EP to the early-arriving nomad/bishop; Hawkeye crit-killed the nomad T7. Athos fled north to (7,8) and then to (7,14) and died T8EP to E#3/E#4/E#7/E#11; Hawkeye died T9EP. Board now: Eliwood 1 HP, Hector 5 HP carrying Lyn, all in the pocket; enemies stopped advancing (stalemate). The chapter is NOT winnable from here (no Athos, Nergal walled off). The runbook forbids a deliberate restart on attempt >=4, so s01 stopped and is handing this to the human: suggest allowing a Restart Chapter.
- s02 ended attempt 10 (Eliwood attacked at 1 HP -> game over) and restarted.
- Attempt 11 (s02): T1 safe (Lyn to (7,21), Hawkeye rescues her at (6,21); Pent (6,22); Athos (8,20) gives Armads to Hector; Hector rescues Eliwood from (9,19); Louise (7,21)). T2 Athos crit #14 from (10,20), Pent 40 + Hector killed #13, Louise killed #16 (took 18). T3 Athos killed sage from (7,17); Louise Elixir. T4 Athos killed E#8 from (5,18) (axe equipped, no counter); Pent chipped E#9 and was hit to 1 HP. T5 killed E#9, but the nomad/bishop door (4,23) AND the generals opened that turn. T6 Athos killed E#11, Pent chipped E#10 (Athos counter killed it); Pent+Louise died T6EP. T7 the pocket with no plug: the nomad reached (12,22) INSIDE it and killed Hawkeye (carrying Lyn, doubled + crit). T8 Lyn trapped -> lost. Athos also got stuck at (13,19) (dead end behind the paladin).
- Door timing seen: sage room opens by T2EP, warriors T3EP, nomad/bishop + generals T5, Hero/paladin T6. With no plug, the nomad (Move 8) gets into the pocket by T7. Plug (12,23) BEFORE T6EP, and only with Athos.
- Attempt 12 (s02): same T1. T2 Athos 26 + Hector 21 + Pent finished #14; Hawkeye crit-killed #13 from (9,23); Louise killed #16. T3 the sage stopped at (5,15), out of reach; it Bolted Hector twice (47->3). T4 Louise (crit) killed the sage from (7,21) and Athos killed E#8 from (6,19); Pent died at (12,21) in the pocket (the generals came out at (12-13,19); 0x17 is probably a JAVELIN even though fe7_threat lists it as 1-1) and Louise died to E#9. T5 E#9 died on Athos's counter at (6,17). From T6 the WHOLE enemy army chases Athos: Hawkeye plugging (12,23)/(12,24) kept the lords safe and killed the bishop (crit). Athos at the warriors' doorway (3,18) killed the nomad and a general on counters, but then he was trapped (the room is a dead end) and the Hero/general killed him on T10.
- Excalibur (0x3D, the nomad's drop) cannot be swung by Athos (weapon list offers only Forblaze). Athos's real damage: Forblaze 44 ATK.
- Big lesson: the enemies swarm whichever unit is outside. A tile with ONE melee approach (the pocket entrance, the (3,18) doorway) plus Athos's 1-2 range counters is how kills happen. Never put Athos in a dead end without an exit.
- Attempt 12 end: with Athos dead, Hawkeye at (12,24) still counter-killed the Hero (T11EP), then died to the paladin; Lyn died T13 -> game over. Mani Katti does 0 to the paladin (Def 21).
- PLAN for attempt 13: FORTRESS = Hawkeye plug at (12,24) (only (11,24) can melee it) + Athos at (12,23) behind him (hits (11,24) and (10,23)). Fully safe interior tiles: (13,22),(14,21),(14,22) for Eliwood/Lyn/Hector; (12,22) is exposed only from (10,22); (12,21)/(13,21) to javelins from (12,19)/(13,19).
- Attempt 13 (s02, best so far): T1-T4 as in attempt 12 (Louise killed the sage from (7,21) on T4, Athos killed E#8 from (6,19), lords dropped at (13,22)/(14,21) with Hector at (14,22)). T5 Pent RESCUED Louise from (11,24) after she fled to (10,24); Athos waited at (5,19) (only E#9 reaches it) and E#9 died on his counter. T6 Hawkeye crit-killed the NOMAD from (9,24) (16 dmg, 59% crit, no double); Athos chipped the bishop. T6EP E#10 died on Athos's counter but Athos fell 40->16. T7 Athos+Pent killed E#11, the bishop is down to 13 (it heals by draining). T8 the Hero (52) + paladin (60) arrived; Hawkeye (30 HP) died to the paladin's DOUBLE javelin inside the pocket at (12,22). T9 the Hero at (11,24): Hector at (12,24) takes 13x2=26 (Hit 100%) vs his 25 HP -> I could not plug; Athos at (12,23) died, then the lords.
- KEY: Hector at FULL HP is the Hero/paladin/general tank at (12,24) (Def 30 there: Hero 13x2, javelin 0). Hector lost 22 to a T2EP Bolting in attempts 12 and 13 because the sage targets the CARRIER (halved avoid). Next time Pent carries Eliwood (Pent Res 20) so Hector stays at 47. Lyn's 0x63 cannot be used.
- Attempt 14 (s02): T2 Athos crit #14, Hawkeye crit #13, Pent killed #16 point-blank (21x2) -> no damage taken; Bolting missed. T3 Athos killed the sage at (5,17) from (7,17). Pocket formation was FLAWLESS (lords at (14,21)/(14,22), Hector plug (12,24)); Hector crit-killed the nomad from (8,25), Hawkeye+Hector killed the bishop. But Athos never got back: T4 he went to (11,17) (wrong way), T5 killed E#8 from (8,15), and then the Hero, paladin, generals and E#9 converged on him in the north; he died T7EP to E#9 at 9 HP. Later Hector died at the plug (E#11 did 12/turn, then the Hero hit him) -> game over. Pent and Louise cannot rescue Eliwood or Athos (only Louise and Lyn are light enough for Pent).

T8 Athos drank the Elixir (E#11 had hit him). T8EP the bishop drained Hector at (12,24) to 25 and THE HERO arrived and finished him (13x2) -> game over.
